name: ADVENT X steel-cage clutch rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 377 g for the ADVENT X RD-M6205GM-B 1×10 clutch derailleur with steel cage. The aluminum-cage RD-M6205AM-B is a different 302 g reference.
